power.method: PoE (802.3at Type 2 / 802.3bt Type 3 with optional IR)

storage.notes: 30 Days cloud video storage retention (Avigilon Alta); ONVIF Profile S/T/M/G; compatible with Avigilon Unity ACC (requires Unity firmware) and 3rd-party VMS

ip_rating: IP66/IP67 (surface & pendant mount); IP5X dust-only (in-ceiling mount)
features: Up to 360° stitched view from a single camera (3 or 4 modular sensors)
120 dB true HDR (dual exposure); 80 dB without HDR
Optional IR illuminator ring (H4AMH-AD-IRIL1) adds up to 30m/98ft IR range at 0 lux (surface/pendant mount only)
NEMA Type 4X and TS2 rated (surface/pendant mount)
AI analytics: person/vehicle/license plate detection, anomaly detection, loitering, line crossing/counting, audio event detection (gunshot, glass break, alarm, scream, tire screech)
Modular design: any camera module pairs with any mounting adapter (pendant wall, pendant NPT, surface, in-ceiling)
30 Days cloud video storage retention (Avigilon Alta)

frigate.notes: Battery/solar model — stream may be intermittent (wakes on event).
